offers.text: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Lockpick is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

driveoffLines: 🔥 Keerthi takes up a brand and Milagros follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. Lockpick was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Thornfield, Ashford ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

💛 You hold Grandfather's Rope. The summer the oak came down across the driveway, Grandfather showed you the trucker's hitch and made you tie it until your fingers bled. You were eight. The tree moved. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

◈ SYSTEM: "36. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."

📡 The feed floods in — fan art, messages in languages nobody speaks, a countdown that isn't yours. The audience demands Haven for the world feed: SEND your speaker into the light, FEAST the cameras with a grand showing, or DECLINE and let the galaxy watch you say no.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

forfeits.offerText: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Lockpick is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
driveoffLines: 🔥 Keerthi takes up a brand and Milagros follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. Lockpick was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)
